title: Nscale and Anthropic Discuss Another $45B Compute Deal
excerpt: Reports indicate that Nscale and Anthropic are in discussions regarding a potential second $45 billion compute agreement.
body_html:
Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly engaged in discussions for a new compute agreement valued at $45 billion. This follows a previous deal of the exact same magnitude that both companies announced back in August.

As demand for large-scale computing infrastructure continues to grow within the artificial intelligence sector, these high-value arrangements highlight the massive resources required to power advanced AI models.
